audit_scope.task: Fresh-context, persuasion-blind semantic audit of all committed Phase 2A verdict rows against the exact Phase 1 operationalizations and original-versus-revised manuscript evidence.
audit_scope.outcome_rule: PASS iff every recorded verdict is supported by the exact committed criterion and the permitted original-versus-revised evidence.

rules_applied: A must_fix or should_fix verdict is judged strictly against its Phase 1 operationalization unless a recorded dissent changes the applied criterion.
FULLY_ADDRESSED requires every conjunct and every literal universal quantifier in the committed fully_addressed pattern.
A navigation hypothesis is not an exhaustive evidence boundary; unchanged manuscript text outside patched blocks remains decision-relevant.

An explicit unavailable or NOT_EVALUABLE statement can satisfy a criterion branch that expressly permits unavailability, but absence or unresolved status is not silently converted into the positive evidence demanded by a different criterion.
A prose consolidation is not the same evidence type as one consolidated table, and an unexecuted comparison contract is not the same evidence type as a conditional lemma.
New issues must be item-untraceable and carry typed attribution; residual failures of an existing criterion stay with that roadmap item.
The DA seat is never a Phase 2A verification persona; a DA-only item routes to EIC.

auditor_provenance.independence_disclosure: Fresh invocation context and persuasion blindness are provenance properties only. This audit uses the same model family and does not establish statistically or causally independent errors.
